doc: -d mean(compose)/d t by central difference with step 0.05 at 32 thresholds from -6 to 6: the rows with a wide ramp give a finite slope, the saturated tails (all overcast, or cloud-free) have a zero slope and hit the 0.05 floor. Pipeline dtypes (float32 fields, float64 thresholds); the difference of two means is divided by 0.1, which amplifies the float32 roundings of compose. Arguments: s, fine, thr, streak and subtexel are the inputs of that name when listed; an unlisted streak (default 0.0) is the scalar in params, an unlisted subtexel is None; prm holds the GenParams fields compose reads plus sensitivity_step. The floor 0.05 is a literal of the source. Measured: promoting the float32 inputs to float64 changes the output by at most 3.9e-9; one-ulp nudges of every float input and parameter change it by at most 1.1e-7 (worst of 6 random trials); the tolerance is 34x the larger of the two spreads.
